typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Account as string,
		Description as string,
		DlyRealPL as double,
		UnrealPL as double,
		TotalPL as double,
		MTM as double,
		DivIntAmzPrcnt as double,
		ProcessDate as timestamp,
		iso_currency as string,
		ADP as string,
		Cusip as string,
		MarketValue as double,
		AccruedInt as timestamp,
		NetPosition as double,
		UnitCost as double,
		NetChange as double,
		UnitPrice as double,
		MarketPrice as double,
		Client as double,
		YTDRealPL as double,
		AvgYield as double,
		DivIntAmzDllr as double,
		MTDRealPL as double,
		Acct_ADP_USD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Account as string,
		Description as string,
		DlyRealPL as double,
		UnrealPL as double,
		TotalPL as double,
		MTM as double,
		DivIntAmzPrcnt as double,
		ProcessDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		iso_currency as string,
		ADP as string,
		Cusip as string,
		MarketValue as double,
		AccruedInt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NetPosition as double,
		UnitCost as double,
		NetChange as double,
		UnitPrice as double,
		MarketPrice as double,
		Client as double,
		YTDRealPL as double,
		AvgYield as double,
		DivIntAmzDllr as double,
		MTDRealPL as double,
		Acct_ADP_USD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Account,
		Description,
		DlyRealPL,
		UnrealPL,
		TotalPL,
		MTM,
		DivIntAmzPrcnt,
		ProcessDate,
		iso_currency,
		ADP,
		Cusip,
		MarketValue,
		AccruedInt,
		NetPosition,
		UnitCost,
		NetChange,
		UnitPrice,
		MarketPrice,
		Client,
		YTDRealPL,
		AvgYield,
		DivIntAmzDllr,
		MTDRealPL,
		Acct_ADP_USD),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
